items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Class name utility for conditionally joining class strings.

items.name: slot
items.title: Slot
items.description: Slot component for the asChild pattern. Merges props, classNames, styles, and refs.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: SVG loading spinner with size variants. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: animated-icon
items.title: Animated Icon
items.description: Animates icon transitions with preset motion profiles (default and micro) using AnimatePresence.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy control with icon, inline, or addon variants, animated success/failure feedback, and clipboard fallback support.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible button with primary/secondary variants, four sizes, icon support, and loading state.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Accessible tooltip with skip-delay grouping, arrow, animated entrance, and dark theme. Built on Base UI Tooltip.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Accessible text input with label, description, error, icon slots, hint tooltip, leading/trailing addons, and first-class trailingAction support. Built on Base UI Field.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Accessible numeric input with stepped keyboard controls, min/max bounds, leading/trailing addon support, and label/description/error. Built on Base UI NumberField.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Accessible dropdown select with icon sync, groups, separators, descriptions, and multi-select. Built on Base UI Select.

items.name: segment-control
items.title: Segment Control
items.description: Segmented control with smooth sliding indicator animation. Built on Base UI ToggleGroup.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline tab navigation with animated indicator. Two sizes, horizontal/vertical orientation, optional border. Built on Base UI Tabs.

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: useCopyToClipboard
items.description: Hook for copying text with clipboard API + fallback and automatic reset timer.
